raw_comment: What I have noticed in this graph is that there are very high drought in more the upper northern states and lower southern states. When looking at this I can tell that eastern and western states are less venerable to extreme droughts. Another interesting thing I found when looking at this graph is how Florida  and Alaska are the only 2 places that have little to no droughts.
